headline: Approved minutes of two earlier meetings, then moved into non-public session.
summary: Minutes from October 29 and November 9, 2026 were approved with no dissenting votes. A vote then moved the group into non-public session under RSA 91-A:3, II (b).
decisions: Approved the October 29, 2026 and November 9, 2026 meeting minutes with no dissenting votes.

decision_evidence.quote: Councilor Grady Sexton moved approval of the October 29, 2026 and the November 9, 2026 meeting minutes. The motion was duly seconded by Councilor Schultz and passed with no dissenting votes.

decision_titles: Approval of October 29 and November 9, 2026 meeting minutes
plain_text:
Ad-Hoc City Manager Search Committee 
Draft Meeting Minutes 
November 16, 2026  
City Council Chambers 
37 Green Street  
6:00 PM 
1. Mayor Champlin called the meeting to order at 6:03 p.m. 
 
2. Roll Call.  
 
Present:  Councilor Brown, Mayor Champlin, Councilors Grady-Sexton, Horne, Kalob, 
Keach, Kretovic, Kurtz, Schultz and Todd 
 
Late:   Councilors Fennessy and Sekou 
 
Excused:  Councilors Davie, Foote and Schlosser 
 
Staff Members Present:  City Clerk Janice Bonenfant, City Solicitor John Conforti and 
Jennifer Johnston, Director of Human Resources and Labor Relations 
 
3. Mayor Champlin provided an overview of the meeting. 
 
4. Approval of Meeting Minutes 
 
• October 29, 2026 
• November 9, 2026 
  
Action: Councilor Grady Sexton moved approval of the October 29, 2026 and the 
November 9, 2026 meeting minutes.  The motion was duly seconded by Councilor Schultz 
and passed with no dissenting votes. 
 
5. Non-public session in accordance with RSA 91-A:3, II (b) 
 
Action:  Councilor Kalob moved to enter non-public session in accordance with RSA 91-
A:3, II (b).  The motion was duly seconded by Councilor Grady Sexton and passed with no 
dissenting votes.

6. Adjournment. 
 
Action:  At 6:48 p.m., Councilor Fennessy moved to exit the non-public session and 
adjourn the Ad-Hoc City Manager Search Committee meeting.  The motion was duly 
seconded and passed with no dissenting votes.
